matched: Machine learning involves optimization of multiple parameters during learning process
Cross-validation (k-fold CV) is straightforward method splitting training data into k subsets (k-1 training, 1 validation)
Two subsets are used to obtain model with least generalization error
CV requires substantial amount of time through repeated re-training and re-verification
Heuristic intelligent optimization algorithms significantly improve model performance and convergence rate
Intelligent optimization algorithms draw inspiration from natural, biological, or physical phenomena
Common algorithms include GA, PSO, SA, artificial bee colony, ant colony optimization, FFA, BA, and GWO
Algorithms are widely used to solve optimization problems with high efficiency and accuracy, each with strengths and weaknesses
